import React from "react";
import classNames from "classnames";

import { _t } from "../../../languageHandler";
import AccessibleButton from "../elements/AccessibleButton";

type Props = Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof AccessibleButton>, "size"> & { size?: string };

export default function CancelButton({ size = "16", className, style, ...props }: Props): JSX.Element {
    return <AccessibleButton
        {...props}
        element={props.element ?? "button"}
        type={props.type ?? "button"}
        aria-label={props["aria-label"] ?? _t("Cancel")}
        className={classNames("mx_CancelButton", className)}
        style={{ "--cancel-button-size": `${size}px`, ...style } as React.CSSProperties}
    />;
}
